harass-desc: Harassment kit: each walker's act budget, tonight's acts, one act on demand, and a self-test
harass-status-desc: Shows each haunting walker's act budget, tonight's counts and the last five acts against its victim, or those within the given radius of you
harass-act-desc: Runs one act now for every haunting walker (or those within the given radius), under the act's own rules: its switch, stage, time of day and nightly cap
harass-selftest-desc: Checks every act with a playerbot stand-in and a small test house above the world spawn; for the headless smoke test
harass-status-line: Harassment: {0} walker(s) haunting, {1} act(s) tonight, {2} change(s) on its own restore list
harass-status-walker: {0} #{1} on {2}: stage {3}, {4}, budget {5} of {6}, next act in {7} s, held back by: {8}
